title: The flaw of flat lists: Treating finished work equal to future ideas
text: Start to finish, all in both formats. And a Suffolk University lecture coming up with Yatra, plus the presentation being built for it. All three, same weight. That's the problem, though. A flat list treats I published an article the same as I'm still building slides for a lecture that hasn't happened yet. So, revise it. Split what's actually finished from what's just starting. text: Being built. Nothing here is finished yet. That's the point of saying so. So, that's the real log. One article shipped, four videos actually produced, and one lecture still ahead of me, presentation and all. Separating done from next isn't a small detail. It's the difference between a recap and a highlight reel. Your turn, same prompt, your week. Ask Claude for your own recap script split the same way, done and starting.
